candidates.change_summary: Remove the require statement that checks for overflow in the balance update, potentially allowing silent overflow.
Replace the unlock time assignment so that it always uses the passed _unlockTime, even if it is in the past.
Replace the unlock time assignment so that it always uses block.timestamp.
Log a different constant string, e.g., 'Put2', changing the event data emitted.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage statement, so Put no longer emits a log.
Change the subtraction to addition so balance increases instead of decreases.
Change the condition to use OR instead of AND for unlockTime check, allowing premature withdrawal.
Remove the balance subtraction so the internal bookkeeping balance does not decrease after withdrawal.
Change MinSum check to require balance greater than MinSum instead of greater or equal.
